effect.name: NTSC Signal Emulation
effect.desc: Emulates an NTSC/VHS composite video signal: luma/chroma are encoded onto a subcarrier and demodulated with per-scanline phase error, producing rainbow crosstalk, dot crawl, luma smear, head-switching tear, tracking noise, snow, and interlace artifacts. Grouped controls cover signal filtering, noise, head switching, and tracking.
